_schema: phases: ordered list of day phases {id, name (Vietnamese HUD label), seconds (real seconds the phase lasts, greater than 0)}. days_per_season: whole days before the season switches (at least 1). seasons: ordered list of {id (must match ids in crops.json 'seasons'), name (Vietnamese HUD label)}; the cycle repeats after the last one. max_step_seconds: longest slice of real time one tick may add (greater than 0, at most the shortest phase); a longer frame is cut to this, so a stall or a return from the background never skips a phase (ADR-0004 rule 1). day_speed: factor applied to each slice per speed mode; needs normal (greater than 0), slow and stop (0 or more); stop freezes the clock, sleeping still ends the day (ADR-0004 rule 4).
